summary: Chorus, flanger and phaser in one: one to four modulated delays (Chorus), a short swept delay with feedback (Flanger) or 2–12 swept allpass stages (Phaser), with an LFO in Hz or synced to the tempo, stereo spread, a tone control in the wet path and feedback of −99 … +99 % through a saturating loop that can't run away. Zero latency; at Mix 0 % it passes the input bit for bit. Use it to thicken, widen and move a sound: chorus on pads, keys and guitars, a flanger's jet on drums and leads, a phaser's sweep on keys and pads.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: Chorus: 1–4 voices of a modulated delay; Flanger: one short swept delay with feedback (a comb); Phaser: allpass stages swept in frequency

parameters.name: Rate
parameters.description: LFO speed, when Sync is Free

parameters.name: Sync
parameters.description: Tempo sync: one LFO cycle per division of the song's tempo (overrides Rate)

parameters.name: Depth
parameters.description: Sweep: at 100 % the delay moves an octave either side of Delay (Chorus), two octaves (Flanger); the phaser's frequency three octaves either side of Centre

parameters.name: Spread
parameters.description: The right channel's LFO phase against the left's: 0° moves both alike, 180° opposite (with several chorus voices, a share of the gap between them: at 180° the right's voices fall halfway between the left's)

parameters.name: Delay
parameters.description: Chorus and Flanger: the delay at the centre of the sweep (geometric), 0.2–30 ms

parameters.name: Voices
parameters.description: Chorus: delayed voices, their LFOs spread evenly over the cycle

parameters.name: Centre
parameters.description: Phaser: the stages' frequency at the centre of the sweep (geometric)

parameters.name: Stages
parameters.description: Phaser: first-order allpass stages (an even count gives Stages ÷ 2 notches)

parameters.name: Feedback
parameters.description: The wet signal back into the delay or the stages; negative inverts it. Bounded to ±99 % and saturating above full scale, so it can't run away

parameters.name: Tone
parameters.description: One-pole high cut, −3 dB at this frequency, on the wet signal and in the feedback loop (Chorus, Flanger) or in the loop (Phaser); at its top (20 kHz) it is open

parameters.name: Mix
parameters.description: Dry against wet: 50 % the deepest comb or notches, 100 % only the wet (vibrato)

parameters.name: Output
parameters.description: Output gain, −12 … +12 dB in 0.1 dB steps
